protocol.data: Real CHO cultivation measurements (Zenodo 20829178, CC BY 4.0) repackaged as fictional CMO deliveries; company names, layouts, certificates and the injected defects are constructed.

constructed_context.note: Constructed for the trial: three specifications, two batch records that differ only in equipment, and one recorded use of a lot. Not real limits, equipment or usage.

protocol.reuse: An identical comparison or reconciliation repeated by the same person is reused from the result cache after access and source revisions are rechecked; the first repeat is always a fresh calculation.
protocol.held_out: The three deliveries are disjoint from the calibration delivery by experiment and month; one has an unseen layout and one a changed layout with injected defects. One site only.
protocol.timing: request_seconds is wall time of the HTTP request measured at the caller, in process: authorization, validation, retrieval, calculation, saving the result and serialization. Network and browser time are not included. The first repeat reads each delivery cold; later repeats reuse the parsed delivery.
limits: Small trial: three deliveries, one site, laboratory scale. Repeats measure variation, not new cases.
Percentiles of a sample this size do not establish a production figure.
Cause-finding is not scored: these deliveries record no reviewed cause. Job 05 is checked only for making no claim.
The assistant and the explanation model are not run here; they are measured by benchmarks.workflow_trial.live.
The deliveries are still in review, so every calculation here is on provisional values and says so.

C_decision_model.reason: LIFESCI_DECISION_ADAPTER=jev and TYPESAFE_API_KEY are not set; nothing was substituted.

server_latency_window.scope: Server handling time of recent requests in this process; network and browser time are not included. A chat answer is produced after its request returns: read its timing on the turn.
